newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's IRSA buys 50 pct of Altos de Quilmes.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's IRSA buys 50 pct of Altos de Quilmes.

text.p: Argentine real estate developer IRSA said Friday it has bought property company Altos de Quilmes for $45.75 million and secured an option to buy another 50 percent for $50 million.
Altos de Quilmes has stakes in several retail chains, including ownership of the Alto Avellaneda Mall, and has a joint controlling stake in Alto Palermo Shopping Argentino, an IRSA statement said.
IRSA said it paid $30.75 million Friday, with the remaining $15 million to be paid for the 50 percent stake on August 26.
The option is only exercisable by the seller. Altos de Quilmes can only exercise its sell option after a year.
Last month IRSA bought local shopping centre Paseo Alcorta for $54 million.
